title: A Gepner stability condition on every smooth quintic threefold
summary: We prove Toda's normalized quintic Gepner conjecture. On every smooth complex quintic threefold, we construct a numerical Bridgeland stability condition for which tensoring by the hyperplane bundle, followed by the spherical twist at the structure sheaf, increases phase by 2/5.
family_title: Gepner symmetry and large-volume stability on threefolds

review.reason: Proves a conjecture on Bridgeland stability conditions for smooth quintic threefolds.
